title: Analytic: whispering-gallery modes of a metal-rimmed ring, exact bend vs the Bessel ring (em_modes)
description:
A ring of radius R (bend_radius, swept 30..200 um) filled with n = 1.5, bounded by a metal rim at r = R and by two metal plates 20 nm apart (pec y_lo / y_hi), seen in cross-section by em_modes (mode_analysis at 1.55 um, group index on, bend_model exact): x is the radial direction (the rim is the x_hi wall plane, the inner face of the outermost cell, x_wall = 24.99 um; bend_reference_x = x_wall, so n_eff is referred to the rim radius and nu = k0 n_eff R is the azimuthal order), y the ring axis. The plates cut off every mode with y dependence, leaving the E_y (TEM-like, E along the ring axis) family, which hugs the rim: whispering-gallery modes.
Exact ring (Bessel): E_y ~ J_nu(k0 n r) with J_nu(k0 n R) = 0, nu = beta R = k0 R n_eff. Olver's expansion of the k-th zero, alpha_k = a_k / 2^(1/3) (a_k the Airy zeros 2.33811, 4.08795): k0 n R = nu + alpha_k nu^(1/3) + (3/10) alpha_k^2 nu^(-1/3) + (5 - alpha_k^3)/350 nu^(-1) - (479 alpha_k^4 + 20 alpha_k)/63000 nu^(-5/3) (next term below 1e-7 relative here), solved for nu by fixed-point iteration (4 steps); n_group = C0 d beta / d omega = n / (d(k0 n R) / d nu) (no material dispersion); ring FSR = lambda0^2 / (2 pi R n_group). The exact bend model is the true bent guide (eps, mu x diag(s, s, 1/s), s = r / R), so the remaining error is discretisation only (10 nm cells: ~1e-6 in n_eff).
Conformal map for comparison (bend_model conformal, not run here): eps n^2 (1 + t/R)^2, t = x - x_wall, i.e. the linear (Airy) potential 2 t / R plus t^2 / R^2, n_eff^2 = n^2 - a_1 q + (2/15) a_1^2 q^2 / n^2 with q = (2 n^2 / (k0 R))^(2/3) (curve n_eff_1_conformal_map): it lies below the exact ring by about (4/15) p^2 relative, p = 1.8558 (k0 n R)^(-2/3): ~9e-4 at R = 30 um, ~5e-4 at 50 um, ~7e-5 at 200 um. Switching bend_model to conformal reproduces that curve.
Derived values tab (base R = 50 um, the last sweep value): n_eff_1 ~1.4385, n_eff_2 ~1.3926, n_group_1 ~1.4795 and FSR_1_nm ~5.17 nm against the Bessel ring (tolerances 2e-5 to 5e-5 relative); te_fraction_1 = 0 (E along y).
Sweep tab: n_eff_1, n_eff_2 and n_group_1 versus R with the dashed Bessel references, plus the conformal-map formula dashed without a tolerance.
The validation warning that x_hi is pec, not cpml, is expected: the outer side of this bend is the metal rim, so the modes are lossless (no bend radiation). Field tab: e_intensity of mode 1 (Snapshot slider: modes 1-3).

parameters.name: n_core
parameters.description: refractive index of the ring filling

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the mode solve

parameters.name: k_vac
parameters.description: vacuum wavenumber k0 [1/m] (k0 is the Bessel K_0 function)

parameters.name: R_bend
parameters.description: rim radius = bend_radius [m]; swept 30..200 um (must exceed x_wall)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size

parameters.name: L_x
parameters.description: radial extent of the cross-section (the modes decay as Ai: < 1e-12 at the inner pec wall for R <= 200 um)

parameters.name: x_wall
parameters.description: x of the rim wall plane (inner face of the outermost x_hi cell) = bend_reference_x

parameters.name: a_1
parameters.description: first zero of Ai(-z)

parameters.name: a_2
parameters.description: second zero of Ai(-z)

parameters.name: alpha_1
parameters.description: Olver coefficient of the first Bessel zero (1.8557571)

parameters.name: alpha_2
parameters.description: Olver coefficient of the second Bessel zero

parameters.name: c3_1
parameters.description: nu^-1 coefficient, zero 1

parameters.name: c4_1

parameters.description: nu^-5/3 coefficient, zero 2
